research.facts:
CPSC Holiday Pajama Recall Wave — November 2026
**Key Facts:**
- Qpancy recalls children's pajama sets (recall #27-094) — burn hazard, violates mandatory federal flammability standards — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Qpancy pajamas sold on Amazon.com from March 2026 through August 2026 — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Qpancy price: approximately $20 — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Qpancy seller: Shanghai Shengkailong Trading Co., Ltd., dba Qpancy — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Qpancy remedy: stop use immediately, cut pajamas in half, email photo to company for full refund — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- No incidents or injuries reported for Qpancy recall — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Mallimoda children's pajama sets also recalled in 2026 — burn hazard, violates mandatory standards, sold on Amazon — HIGH (cpsc.gov URL)
- Black Sheep Fam recalls children's pajamas — burn hazard, violates mandatory flammability standards — HIGH (cpsc.gov URL)
- Veseacky pajama sets recalled in 2026 — burn hazard, violates mandatory standards — HIGH (cpsc.gov URL)
- SHEIN toy sets recalled November 12, 2026 — approximately 265,000 units — consumers told to stop use and seek refund — HIGH (CPSC, prior search result)
- Parents can check the full recall list at cpsc.gov/Recalls — HIGH (cpsc.gov)
- Children's sleepwear must meet mandatory flammability standards (either flame-resistant fabric or snug-fitting design) — HIGH (federal law, cpsc.gov context)
**Sources:**
- CPSC Qpancy recall: https://cpsc.gov/Recalls/2027/Qpancy-Recalls-Childrens-Pajama-Sets-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Burn-Hazard-Violate-Mandatory-Standards-for-Childrens-Sleepwear
- CPSC Mallimoda recall: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Mallimoda-Childrens-Pajama-Sets-Recalled-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Burn-Hazard-Violates-Mandatory-Standards-for-Childrens-Sleepwear-Sold-on-Amazon-by-Mallimoda
- CPSC Black Sheep Fam recall: https://cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/The-Black-Sheep-Fam-Recalls-Childrens-Pajamas-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Burn-Hazard-Violates-Mandatory-Flammability-Standards-for-Childrens-Sleepwear
